description: Archipelago multiworld randomizer client. Main menu > ARCHIPELAGO, pick a fresh pilot, CONNECT. Set the server and slot below first. The pilot you connect is bound to that seed and its unlocks are rewritten by the client.

options.name: Slot name
options.description: Your slot (player) name in the room.

options.name: Password
options.description: Room password, if it has one.

options.name: CA bundle
options.description: Optional path to a CA certificate bundle (.pem) for wss://. Empty = system certificates.
